result.topic_en: The upright top part is a dated note (Göttingen, May 1850) about the timekeeping (a Pennington chronometer's rate and error relative to mean time) used for observations and the constants P, Q, log R, log S of the bifilar magnetometer. The larger, mostly inverted remainder is a dense Kurrent draft, apparently on surfaces, points and functions, that is largely illegible.
